name: Ethiopia
prevalence_note: Ethiopia 2025-2026 warnings: ethiopia Mobile Wallet & Bank OTP Vishing Scam; false Medical Emergency & Acquaintance Impersonation Scam.
cross_border_note: Calls in Swahili, Amharic, French or English, often from local mobile numbers.

scams.name: የሞባይል ቦርሳ እና የባንክ ማረጋገጫ ኮድ (OTP) ማጭበርበር
scams.name_en: Ethiopia Mobile Wallet & Bank OTP Vishing Scam
scams.signals_en: Fraudsters call posing as telecom staff or bank officers in Ethiopia, claiming a mobile wallet or bank account needs urgent upgrading or faces suspension.
scams.legit_en: According to the National Bank of Ethiopia and telecom security advisories, legitimate financial institutions and mobile operators never ask customers to reveal PINs, passwords, or one-time verification codes over unsolicited calls, nor send external app.
bait_tactics: አንድ ጊዜ ይጠብቁኝ፣ ኔትወርኩ እዚህ ቤት ውስጥ በጣም ደካማ ስለሆነ ምንም አጭር መልዕክት ገና አልገባልኝም።
መነጽሬን ሳሎን ውስጥ ጥዬው መጣሁ፣ ትንንሽ ቁጥሮቹን ማንበብ ስለማልችል ሄጄ ላምጣው።
የስልኬ ባትሪ አንድ ፐርሰንት ላይ ደርሶ ሊዘጋ ነው፣ ቻርጀር እስክፈልግ ትንሽ ይታገሱኝ።

scams.name: False Medical Emergency & Stranded Relative Mobile Money Scam
scams.name_en: False Medical Emergency & Acquaintance Impersonation Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: send money to this temporary number
do not call anyone else right now

scams.signals_en: Scammers call from an unfamiliar number or use a hijacked account to pose as a relative, colleague, or hospital staff member claiming a loved one had a sudden road accident or arrest.
scams.legit_en: Genuine hospitals and public authorities follow standard admission and family notification procedures without demanding instant mobile money transfers to private numbers.
bait_tactics: Hold on, the line has terrible static—which clinic reception desk did you say you're calling from?
Wait a minute, my mobile wallet balance is nearly zero right now and the nearest agent shop is closed.
Let me find a pen to write down the doctor's name first because my screen keeps freezing.
